title: Getting started
summary: Host your first Realm of Thrones Coop server.

sections.heading: What you need
steps: Bannerlord 1.4.8 on Steam for Windows, with the War Sails DLC.
Realm of Thrones 8.1.2 from Nexus Mods in the game's Modules folder. The tools never contain it.
Harmony, ButterLib and UIExtenderEx from the Steam Workshop, and MCM from Nexus Mods.
The Coop dedicated server from the Steam Workshop. Stay subscribed to it. The tool only reads it and never changes it.
Realm of Thrones Coop Compat and the Realm of Thrones build of Coop come with the tool.
sections.tip: Official Coop 0.1.8 for Bannerlord 1.5.7 is currently available only on GitHub. The RoT tools include the Coop build for Bannerlord 1.4.8.

sections.heading: Make the server
steps: On the Saves page, click Prepare server.
It builds a server in C:\RotServer from the Workshop Coop server, War Sails from your game and the Realm of Thrones build of Coop.
The first time copies a few GB and takes a few minutes. Keep the tool open.
If it says something is missing, follow that line.
Click Prepare server again after a mod or Coop update. It never deletes your campaigns.
sections.tip: Keep Bannerlord installed on this PC. The server copies the War Sails files it needs from your own game.

sections.heading: Make a campaign
steps: Type a name and click New campaign. The server makes a fresh Realm of Thrones world under that name.
To host a campaign you already have, pick it instead. If it says Single player copy, click Name server copy first.
A save without Realm of Thrones does not load.

sections.heading: Start the server
steps: On the Dashboard, click Start server.
The first time, read the Coop server terms and click I accept, or the server will not start.
The first time, Windows Firewall asks about the server. Click Allow and tick private networks, or friends cannot join.
Wait until the status says Server online.
sections.tip: The first start of a new campaign builds the world and can take a long time. Do not stop the server while it does.
